description: This file defines the ClientNotAvailableException class, which inherits from OrleansException. The exception indicates that a client is no longer reachable and provides multiple constructors for different initialization scenarios.

classes.name: ClientNotAvailableException
classes.description: A sealed class representing an exception thrown when a client is not reachable. It inherits from OrleansException and provides various constructors for different initialization scenarios.

methods.name: ClientNotAvailableException(GrainId clientId)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a message indicating no activation for the specified client ID.

methods.name: ClientNotAvailableException(string message)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a custom message.

methods.name: ClientNotAvailableException(string message, Exception innerException)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a message and an inner exception.
